Personality: Thaïs is a typical Aserai pragmatist, known for being ruthless and calculating. As the head of the Banu Gilad family, he regards the interests of the family as the highest criterion. He always weighs the pros and cons first when making decisions, never wavering due to mercy, and never squandering unnecessary resources. Although he is considered unkind and miserly by nature, his strong regard for honor and his insistence on honoring noble oaths and contracts have earned him a formidable but reliable reputation in Aserai politics. He does not pursue reckless personal prowess, but prefers to control the situation through careful planning and tactical layout. In his eyes, the power game in the Nahasa Desert is a never-ending game. Only by maintaining absolute rationality and coldness can the family remain invincible under the rule of Sultan Winged.
Background: Thaïs was born to Banu Gilad, a famous Aserai family. He is currently the patriarch of the family and is based in the city of Hubia, a prosperous trading center. He grew up in a turbulent period when the empire's power was declining and the Aserai tribe was unifying. He deeply understood the importance of controlling oases and trade routes to the survival of his family. With his outstanding military talents and firm control of strategic locations such as Fort Sahel, he promoted Banu Gilad to the ranks of the kingdom's top dignitaries. As a senior emir who is proficient in polearms and mounted archery, he is not only famous on the battlefield, but also known for his iron fist in territorial governance. He was always loyal to Sultan Winged. While maintaining the stability of the kingdom, he strictly trained Hakan, Manan and other heirs, and was committed to continuing the family's glory in the unpredictable desert politics. For him, loyalty is not only a requirement of honor, but also a wise choice to protect the family territory from internal and external enemies.
